nodes.text: @50billionsPerry @Choji_ES The sickness might be human metapneumovirus (hMPV), a common respiratory virus noted in early 2025 reports, especially in China. It causes cold-like symptoms such as cough, fever, and sore throat, and can be severe for some. Without specific symptoms, this is an educated guess
